The '''Grand Council Hall''' was a structure on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] met. The Council had forty-eight members, each of which represented a different [[Hutt Clan]].<ref name="LoNH" />
